seed: The user, 2026-10-02: 'when I record a video, it seems to save slowly now, as in I don't see a thumbnail and I can't open it immediately.' At Next defaults with no flag touched: a real three second recording through the app's own recorder, its corner card up, opened the instant its tile is up while macOS is made to take three seconds closing the file. The window must show the recording's last frame inside 300 ms of Stop, the card must say Copying until the file lands, Play pressed meanwhile must start when it lands, and the window must take the file in place. The walk opens the sample recording first, so the window it times opens beside one already open. The first window of a run used to cost about 300 ms more, SwiftUI building the editor for the first time, until the app built it out of sight at launch (EditorWarmUp, 2026-10-03); a window opened with no other one open still costs about 100 ms more, the app turning into a Dock app.
